title: Erlang: The Movie (Fixed Audio)
summary: A 12-minute film in which Erlang's creators demonstrate the language's fault tolerance and live-system features, including phoning each other to show it working. This version has fixed audio.
why: HN recommends it as a charming, concise demonstration of what makes Erlang special, from the people who built it.

quote.text: the most glorious 11 minutes of some programmers explaining how their creation works you will ever see
